show.title: Soulection Radio Show #139 w/ DJ Harrison
show.content:
DJ Harrison thows down a crazy live improvised session with the SP-404 and MPC1000

<!--more-->

oe Kay started off with some nice deep/melodic tracks from Mr. Carmack, Christoph El Truento, Dirg Gerner, Iamnobodi, Sango, Last Night In Paris, Geode and many more! Joe took it back to the essence with Ginuwine/Timbaland/Dilla classics! DJ Harrison on the other hand who reminds us of Madlib (no really he does)all the way from Virginia threw down a crazy live session with the SP-404 & MPC 1000. Lots of soulful chops and intricate drum patterns! This is another amazing session from start to finish! Spread this if you feel it.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #149 w/ House Shoes
show.content:
The pioneer/legendary House Shoes kicks off exclusives from label Street Corner Music.

<!--more-->

This man's musical selections, experiences/knowledge, and blunt personality is one that you can't deny. 

We respect House Shoes! It was nice to finally have him come by and drop two different sets (that's right two!). 

He kicked it off with exclusives from his new label Street Corner Music and then ended with some nice soulful joints. 

Joe Kay's discussion with Shoes also touched on many great subjects that many of you wanted to know. Enjoy.



Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
